_comment: Two trees, two currencies. MEMORY is bought with memories (understanding things: the right objects, the right people). GAMEPLAY is the infection's: bought with shards (Gutterspace nuggets, and what the god gives for a kill). Gameplay makes the hunters keener; Memory calms them. Names and descriptions NEW unless noted (carried from the earlier build).

memory.name: Faces
memory.desc: You've been in rooms with these people before. You know them when you see them, and they can tell.

memory.name: Her Handwriting
memory.desc: You know whose hand that is. Letters and notes tell you more. (earlier build)

memory.name: Old Name
memory.desc: Somebody used to shout a name at you across rooftops, and you'd turn round. (earlier build)

memory.name: How She Moves
memory.desc: You've known her a long time. You can feel where she is when she's close. (earlier build)

memory.name: These Walls
memory.desc: You've been inside walls before. You see the chalk marks somebody left, and where the passages double back.

memory.name: The Bow
memory.desc: Your shoulders remember drawing it. Things you throw go further, and land where you mean. (earlier build)

gameplay.name: Quiet Feet
gameplay.desc: Footsteps carry half as far. (earlier build)

gameplay.name: Deep Lungs
gameplay.desc: Something in your chest that wasn't there. You run longer and breathe quieter.

gameplay.name: The Pull
gameplay.desc: Want a thing hard enough and it comes to your hand. Six metres. It's not a nice feeling.

gameplay.name: Coral Grip
gameplay.desc: Your right hand closes harder than a hand should. Locks, chains, hinges.

gameplay.name: Dark Eyes
gameplay.desc: The dark stops being dark. Things in it see you seeing.

gameplay.name: Headshot
gameplay.desc: A shot to the head kills outright. Anything. (earlier build)
